definition: A plan diagram the brief asks for by name. The composer guarantees it a place among the candidates and scores it like any other; if its own ranking would not return it, it is added after them and displaces none.
more: The lot can still rule it out, and the result then says why. A brief whose named diagram cannot be built on the brief's own massing is refused before anything is composed.
basis: Our wording of the composer's guarantee. build/compose.py, pick_partis: "A parti named by the brief is guaranteed a place among the candidates: it is scored by the same arithmetic as every other diagram, never given a bonus for being named, and if the cut falls above it, its row is kept past the cut anyway."; build/compose.py, compose: "appended after the set as one more candidate and displaces nothing"; build/compose.py, check_brief_refs: "A brief whose named parti contradicts the brief's own massing is refused by name before a job starts, and never silently re-picked".
